import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static int solve(List<Integer> v) {
        int sum = v.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).sum();
        return sum / v.size();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            v.add(sc.nextInt());
        }
        System.out.println(solve(v));
        sc.close();
    }
}
